C0576.title: Eight Individuals Convicted of False Advertising for Organizing Fake Reviews and Sales
C0576.summary: In July 2025, the Dunhua City People's Court in Jilin Province concluded a case involving fake reviews and transaction fraud. The defendants, including Xiao Ming, purchased order-brushing software and set up a studio to organize 'brushers' to conduct fake transactions and post fabricated positive reviews for Taobao merchants, accumulating illegal gains of 272,000 yuan.
